core_hypothesis: Hodgson's research establishment was fiscally heterogeneous and institutionally hybrid: private expenditure supported research capacity, while key actors could also occupy Residency offices and household/logistical roles. Research labour, administrative status and payment source should therefore be reconstructed independently rather than inferred from one another.
